residualGaps: Recipe commit chosen as conan-recipes main HEAD (last push 2026-08-14, before the 3.7.9 tag on 2026-09-01); the CI may also have consumed prebuilt binaries from audacity-binaries-conan2 built from an earlier recipe revision with identical version pins (no CI log available). Version resources/strings confirm zlib, libpng, expat, jpeg-turbo, lame, FLAC, opus, vorbis, sndfile, wavpack, curl, portaudio, wx; mpg123, ogg, opusfile, libid3tag, portmidi, threadpool, rapidjson, crashpad versions rest on the conanfile pins only. wxWidgets fork codeload archive (20.46 MB) was stream-counted (not stored) to get its size. libuuid/breakpad/catch2 are pinned in conanfile but not shipped on Windows (no DLL; crashpad engine is default). FFmpeg is not shipped (mod-ffmpeg loads a user-installed FFmpeg). Some recipe patches (portmidi, portaudio, lame, vst3sdk, wx) live only in the conan-recipes archive, which is listed as build recipe. GitHub codeload archives are generated on the fly; their bytes can differ in future regenerations.
